bg-image.$description: Optional image layered over the tree surface.

backdrop-filter.$description: Complete backdrop filter behind the surface.

hover-bg.$description: Fill of an unselected row hovered by a fine pointer.

hover-fg.$description: Text of an unselected row hovered by a fine pointer.

selected-bg.$description: Fill of a selected or checked row.

selected-fg.$description: Text and glyph ink on a selected row.

icon-fg.$description: Default ink of the decorative row icons.

row-height.$description: Minimum block size before density adjustment.

touch-row-min.$description: Minimum row block size on a coarse pointer.

padding.$description: Interior padding of the hierarchy surface.

edge-width.$description: Width of the surface and checkbox outlines.

edge.$description: Perimeter color of the hierarchy surface.

focus-ring-width.$description: Width of the focused row outline.

focus-ring-color.$description: Ink of the focused row outline.

radius.$description: Rounding of a highlighted item row.

gap.$description: Space between an optional item icon and its label.

padding.$description: Inline-end inset of an item row.

target.$description: Minimum inline target of a disclosure or checkbox.

box-size.$description: Size of the visual checkbox indicator.

box-radius.$description: Rounding of the visual checkbox indicator.
